name: kurohelper-ai-runtime
description: Tokenless SillyTavern generation and memory runtime for KuroHelper.

scripts.version: node -e "if(require('child_process').execSync('git branch --show-current').toString().trim()!=='main'){process.stderr.write('Version bumps must be done on main.\n');process.exit(1)}" && cd server && npm install && cd .. && version-everything manifest.json server/package.json && git add manifest.json server/package.json package-lock.json server/package-lock.json
scripts.bump: npm version patch && git push origin HEAD --tags
scripts.bump-minor: npm version minor && git push origin HEAD --tags
scripts.bump-major: npm version major && git push origin HEAD --tags

author: tommy-125 <https://github.com/tommy-125>
